steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A work order needs a permit where its scope needs one, a stock status for each part, and an asset.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Work order with no permit where the scope needs one
findings.fix: Raise the permit before work starts

findings.title: Part with no stock status
findings.fix: Check the stock and record the status

outcome.notChecked: Whether the job is safe to do.

pros: Checks a work order with no permit where the scope needs one, a part with no stock status, and a scope with no asset.
cons: Not checked: Whether the job is safe to do.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-work-order-request skill on the records for this review.
